name: popsicle
headline: AI content creation for Indian businesses
short_description: An intelligent multi-agent system built with Microsoft AutoGen that creates high-quality, culturally relevant content for Indian businesses. Perfect for startups, SMEs, and enterprises looking to scale their content marketing with AI.
author: sameeullahsiddiqui

sections.overview:
Agentic Content Management Team is a multi-agent system built with Microsoft AutoGen that generates high-quality, culturally relevant content tailored for Indian businesses. It coordinates four specialized agents—a project manager, writer, editor, and SEO specialist—to create platform-specific content for Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, and WhatsApp Business. The system includes pre-built industry templates for restaurants, tech startups, e-commerce, education, and healthcare, making it easy to customize for any Indian business vertical. It supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and LM Studio, and can produce social media campaigns, blog articles, product descriptions, and festival promotions at a fraction of traditional agency costs.
Create social media campaigns for local Indian restaurants targeting specific neighborhoods and price ranges
Generate blog articles and thought leadership content for tech startups seeking investor engagement
Produce product descriptions and seasonal campaign content for e-commerce platforms
Develop course descriptions and student success stories for education businesses
sections.setup:

sections.usage:
```
Act as an agentic content management team for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business in India. Generate a 3-month content calendar with culturally relevant topics, formats, and distribution channels. Include SEO optimization tips for each piece. Use [DATA] if provided.
```
